{{Youmay|the goose|the [[wild goose]]}}
A '''goose''' was a creature that bore a thin, multi-jointed neck and waddled when it walked. Because its design mimicked those traits, the [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2-series]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] was nicknamed "goose droid."

{{Creature-stub}}

== Behind the scenes ==
Geese were first mentioned by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the German dub of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]</ref>
